Heights place is calculated from the School column in every race (some tabs number every finisher in their Heights Place column).
Some 2008 Landon (Oct 6) and 2023 Flint Hill times were stored as clock times (e.g. 13:36 read as 13 h 36 min) and are shown as minutes:seconds.

Grades weren't recorded for most 2006–2010 meets, 2022 Covenant Life, 2023 Flint Hill and 2024 Flint Hill/Bullis. For Heights runners the site fills a missing grade from the same runner's other races (same season, or the grade in another season adjusted by the year difference) and shows it in italics.

Race distances come from the divisor in each tab's pace formula (pace = time ÷ miles). The 2010 Landon tabs have no pace formula; per the team those courses were 2.2 mi, so their paces are calculated from that.
Where a tab has no pace for a runner, the site calculates it the same way: time ÷ the race distance.

Team scores are calculated by the site from the listed finishers (standard scoring: teams with 5+ finishers, top 5 score, 6th–7th displace, 8th+ ignored, ties broken by the 6th runner) and compared with official meet scores where those were found online.
Races from 2011–2019 that aren't in the sheet, plus 2021 CLS and 2022 FHS, come from racecast.co / Athletic.net / mocorunning.com (data/supplemental). Each of those meet pages links its source.

2022 States: the meet re-tallied extra runners from deep teams as B teams; the B listing is left out, those runners keep their overall places but don't count in team scores. 2021 States and 2007 Landon Invitational were missing finishers, which were added from the official results. 2025 States did not score 5th graders.
